jobs.title: Head of Data Systems (Google Stack)
jobs.description:
The Head of Data Systems (Google Stack) will play a key role at Stacktics, required to help create and maintain industry-leading quality and efficiency of service and software delivery.

Stacktics will rely on the Head of Data Systems with ownership of the Data Systems function including mentoring and support for our team of engineers, developers, marketing analysts and data scientists. The successful candidate will be expected to meet and exceed Stacktics' quality standards, while helping the organization rapidly expand into increasingly complex application development, data engineering, and related workflows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ownership of Stacktics' Data Systems Business Unit

Build and grow your team's capabilities and expertise to be truly platform-agnostic, ever-adapting based on opportunity and business direction
Lead thorough audits of clients'/prospects' Data Systems, and other associated platforms and technologies as applicable including performance and cloud cost-efficiency
Provide proactive recommendations, identifying areas of opportunity and/or improvement for clients based on their underlying business objectives and goals
Maintain continuous focus on work output quality and reliability, acting as the champion of customer satisfaction in a proactive manner and as the final escalation point for technical and delivery issues that cannot be resolved at the Technical Lead level
Act as Stacktics' primary Data Systems expert, ensuring to maintain and continuously grow personal expertise, and sharing information with other Stacktics team members, client stakeholders and prospects
Collaborate with, support, and work closely with cross-functional units to ensure efficient workflow, and realize cross-functional opportunities and enhancements
Maintain responsibility for the Business Unit's growth and success, continuously developing existing engagements, optimizing resourcing and prospecting
Be dedicated to the success and happiness of your team members, optimizing workflow, enabling their personal growth, and acting as a strong team leader overall

Instilling Development Best Practices and Skills/Procedures Advancement

Establishing, maintaining and evolving DevSecOps best practices and tools, and continuously keeping them aligned with current industry best practices and procedures
Understanding, implementing and automating security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation frameworks
Contributing to deployment tooling within the Stacktics team
Contributing to version control technology frameworks and creating/implementing working processes within the Data Systems team, with tools such as Git or SVN
Own and continuously improve the practice's AI coding standards, the AI coding constitution (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules), PR checklists, and slash commands keeping them current as tools, clients, and the team's needs evolve

Leading in the Software 3.0 Era

AI tools have changed how fast engineering work gets produced. Your job is to make sure that speed shows up as sounder architecture and higher-quality delivery — not just faster shipping of the same judgment gaps.
Recalibrate how the team scopes and estimates work as AI tooling changes what can actually be delivered in a sprint, so timelines and resourcing plans reflect real AI-era delivery speed
Set architecture and coding standards that assume engineers are using AI assistants daily — code review habits, eval frameworks, and quality gates sized to the failure modes of AI-assisted development, not just its speed
Continue evolving Stacktics' AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC) — our AI-native answer to SDLC — piloting new stages against real engagements and driving adoption across the team
Be an active daily user of AI coding assistants yourself, and bring that firsthand experience into how standards and review practices are set for the team
Lead Stacktics’ technical team members through the integration into Agentic AI-first working patterns, and beyond

Code Productization

Migrating the delivery of the most common/universally applicable solutions from custom projects to formally productized software solutions
Advocating for building repeatability, scalability and standardization into how the Stacktics Data Systems team approaches all work, in order to enable the future migration to productization as a general rule

Data Engineering-Specific Responsibilities

Participate in continuous delivery pipelines to fully automate deployment of the highly available cloud platform that supports multiple projects
Design and develop ETL workflows and datasets to be used in data visualization tools
Write complex SQL queries with multiple joins to automate and manipulate data extracts
Perform end to end Data Validation to maintain accuracy of data sets
Build tools for deployment, monitoring and operations
Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the development, test and production environments
Develop re-usable processes that can be leveraged and standardized for multiple instances
Prepare technical specifications and documentation for projects
Stay up to date on relevant technologies, plug into user groups, understand trends and opportunities to ensure we are using the best possible techniques and tools
Understand, implement, and automate security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation

Contribution to Corporate Strategy

Actively and proactively play a key role in steering Stacktics and affiliated companies, considering market developments, competitive maneuvers, unique opportunities, etc.
You will be expected to both bring new ideas to the table and assist other corporate leaders in vetting/developing concepts and tactics
Identification and tracking of performance, coaching, training needs, and motivating members of the Data Systems team — including Senior Technical Leads. Directly or indirectly responsible for hiring, terminating and owning performance evaluations for direct reports and the Data Systems group

Company-Wide Responsibilities

Maintain and exceed client satisfaction with Stacktics’ deliverables, day-to-day work and overall value as a partner
Adapt to ever-changing client needs and expectations
Maintain dedication toward achieving excellence in Stacktics’ delivery against client needs, and overall success as an organization
Ability to provide clear guidance and support for advanced problem solving and system design to large teams at enterprise-level client companies, aiding the evolution of their digital practices

QUALIFICATIONS

Deep expertise in building and managing large-scale data systems on cloud platforms, with a strong preference for Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services
Python, SQL and Cloud Computing
10+ years experience in Data Engineering, including 6+ years in technical leadership or management roles, with experience managing other leads (e.g., Technical Leads or engineering managers).
Strong understanding of and direct experience with managing a team operating in a “Software 3.0” model (Agentic AI-first)
Active user of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent), and fluent in what they change about estimation, architecture, and review
Understanding of digital ecosystems including online data collection, cloud systems and analytics tools (Google Stack, Facebook, Salesforce, Adobe Suite etc.) a strong asset
Strong technical understanding of a range of marketing concepts such as cookie-based data collection, setting and leveraging audience segments, attribution modelling, AB/N & multivariate is an asset
Excellent written & verbal communication skills are essential; candidate should be comfortable presenting and participating in group discussions of concepts with internal and external stakeholders
Candidate must exhibit an analytical, detail-oriented approach to problem solving
Experience with Jira / Atlassian project management tools is an asset

Preferred Qualifications

Google Cloud certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer) are a strong plus.
Prior experience in a consulting environment, managing and delivering projects for multiple clients concurrently.

jobs.title: Director, Digital Product Owner, Scotia Protect Platform
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 275336

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Purpose

The Director, Digital Product Owner, Scotia Protect Platform is responsible for leading the business product management and roadmap execution of the ScotiaProtect Platform across International Banking markets. The incumbent will establish an integrated view of platform priorities, translate market and customer needs into scalable digital solutions, and drive successful delivery through collaboration with country, Digital, Technology, Operations, Data, Risk, Compliance, and insurer partner teams.

This role is accountable for platform adoption, delivery governance, launch readiness, value realization, and ongoing platform evolution while ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives, regulatory requirements, and local market needs.

What You'll Do

Lead Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution

Own and execute the ScotiaProtect Platform roadmap across International Banking markets, translating strategic priorities into platform capabilities, releases, and market deployments.
Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing market needs, business value, and delivery capacity.
Define success measures and business outcomes to support platform growth and scalability.

Drive Platform Standardization & Market Deployment

Champion the adoption of reusable platform capabilities and shared components across markets.
Partner with country insurance and retail banking teams to define deployment strategies, customer journeys, operating models, and launch plans.
Promote standardization and simplification while accommodating appropriate local market requirements.

Govern Delivery & Execution

Lead end-to-end platform governance, including planning, milestone management, dependency tracking, and executive reporting.
Ensure business requirements, customer journeys, operational processes, and delivery artifacts are clearly defined and managed throughout the product lifecycle.
Identify and mitigate delivery risks that may impact scope, timelines, quality, or business outcomes.
Foster Agile product management practices across cross-functional teams to enable effective and efficient delivery.

Build Strategic Partnerships

Collaborate with insurer partners, vendors, country stakeholders, technology teams, and business leaders to support platform delivery and adoption.
Communicate strategy, priorities, progress, risks, and decisions to senior leadership and partner organizations.
Develop and maintain strong relationships that support successful platform execution and long-term growth.

Ensure Risk Management & Operational Readiness

Partner with Risk, Compliance, Privacy, Legal, Security, Technology, and Operations teams to ensure appropriate controls and governance are embedded throughout delivery.
Support launch readiness through testing, training, operational preparedness, support planning, and post-launch monitoring.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, operational risk standards, and internal policies.

Deliver Data-Driven Results

Establish and monitor key performance indicators including digital adoption, customer experience, operational performance, delivery health, and business value realization.
Leverage customer insights and market feedback to continuously enhance platform capabilities and user experience.
Partner with Finance and Analytics teams to align roadmap investments with strategic priorities and expected business outcomes.

Lead & Develop High-Performing Teams

Build, coach, and develop a high-performing product management team.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Support succession planning, talent development, and product management excellence across the organization.

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Operations Management, Design, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
MBA, graduate degree, Agile certification, Product Management certification, or related designation is considered an asset.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital product management, platform leadership, program delivery, banking, insurance, or financial services.
Proven experience leading large-scale, multi-country initiatives and delivering complex digital platforms or products.
Strong knowledge of insurance, bancassurance, financial services, digital distribution, and customer experience management.
Demonstrated expertise in Agile and Lean delivery methodologies.
Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, release planning, launch readiness, and post-launch performance measurement.
Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and decision-making capabilities.
Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, influencing, and negotiation skills.
Experience leading cross-functional teams across business, technology, operations, and external partner organizations.
English language proficiency is required. Spanish language capability is a strong asset.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. - Excellentes compétences analytiques, organisationnelles et de résolution de problèmes.
- Capacité à traduire des données financières complexes en recommandations opérationnelles concrètes.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected, mission-driven organization dedicated to improving well-being and quality of life in the communities it serves. The organization is seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Vice President, Finance to join its Executive Leadership Team. Reporting to the CEO, the Vice President will provide enterprise-wide leadership across Finance and corporate services, while serving as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and senior leadership team.

The organization delivers essential services to a large and diverse client base. Behind every service are countless financial, operational, and strategic decisions that turn resources into meaningful impact. As Vice President, Finance, the successful candidate will ensure the financial strength, insight, and discipline needed to advance the mission and support long-term sustainability.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an accomplished finance executive who combines strategic insight with operational leadership and wants to influence meaningful outcomes in a purpose-driven organization. More than a functional leader, the Vice President will be a key enterprise partner, helping shape strategy, support growth, and position the organization for continued success in a complex operating environment.

The Mandate

The mandate extends well beyond traditional financial stewardship. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the VP will help shape organizational strategy, support evidence-based decision-making, and ensure the long-term sustainability of an organization delivering critical services.

In partnership with the CEO, Board, and senior leadership team, the VP will provide strategic financial leadership across planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, treasury, audit, risk management, and compliance. They will ensure financial resources are aligned with organizational priorities while maintaining the discipline and accountability the mission requires.

A key priority will be supporting the organization through a period of growth and change. Using financial insights and performance data, the VP will help evaluate opportunities, inform strategic initiatives, and optimize the deployment of resources in a complex funding and operating environment. Success will require balancing long-term vision with disciplined execution and sound financial management.

Beyond finance, the VP will provide executive oversight of key corporate services, including procurement and facilities, ensuring effective stewardship of organizational resources and infrastructure. The role will also lead efforts to strengthen internal capabilities, foster collaboration across departments, and build a high-performing, engaged team.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to evolve the finance function from a trusted service provider into an even more proactive strategic partner and to enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. Success will be measured not only by financial outcomes, but also by the ability to influence strategy, support growth, and contribute to long-term sustainability and impact.

Leadership and Stewardship

The organization is seeking a VP Finance who leads with maturity and earns trust through action. This is not a role for someone who relies on title or tenure to get things done. The culture here rewards people who show up prepared, communicate clearly, and follow through.
Operates with humility, credibility, and sound judgment
Brings a practical, solutions-oriented mindset
Communicates clearly and influences at all levels
A good partner to the program managers – asking what they need before explaining what the number say
Leads with integrity, accountability, and transparency

Ideal Background

The successful candidate will bring experience in social services, healthcare, the boarder public sector, or the not-for-profit sector. Those who understand the operational, funding, and stakeholder dynamics of publicly funded organizations will be particular well positioned for success.
A CPA designation and progressive senior finance leadership experience.
Experience leading finance within a complex, multi-stakeholder organization.
A strong understanding of financial planning, financial reporting, treasury, governance, risk management, and internal controls.
Experience working with Boards and senior executives in a strategic advisory capacity.
The ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights.
A collaborative leadership style and a reputation for building strong relationships across an organization.

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to combine executive-level impact with genuine purpose. As a strategic partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, the Vice President, Finance will help shape decisions that influence the organization’s direction, sustainability, and growth.

The successful candidate will join an organization at an exciting point in its journey, with the opportunity to strengthen financial stewardship, support strategic priorities, and help position the organization for continued success. The organization measures its success not only by financial performance, but by the positive impact it has on the people and communities it serves.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of a mission-driven organization, we encourage you to apply in confidence.

jobs.description:
About Staffing®
is an Alberta-based recruitment company that connects jobseekers to employers across Canada. Established in 1996, About Staffing is a proud BBB Accredited business.

We have partnered with a growing financial services organization to support them in hiring for their next Vice President, Finance
.

Job ID: 43264
Job Type: Direct Hire
Category: Accounting & Finance
Location: Calgary, Alberta
Work Model: In-Office

Our SE Calgary client is a growing financial services organization with operations across Canada and the United States. With multiple business entities and a fast-moving environment, the organization is continuing to build scalable financial processes, strengthen reporting capabilities, and support its next stage of growth.

The culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and solutions-focused. This is an environment where priorities can evolve quickly, and leaders are expected to be hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable working across departments. Strong communication and the ability to build effective relationships with senior leadership and cross-functional teams are highly valued.

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), the Vice President, Finance will lead the accounting function across multiple Canadian and United States (US) entities. This is a hands-on leadership position responsible for financial reporting, consolidation, accounting operations, internal controls, compliance, and process improvement. The successful candidate will bring both technical accounting expertise and strong business acumen, with the ability to translate financial information into meaningful insights for senior leadership.

Duties and Responsibilities:

The key job functions are:
Lead the accounting function across multiple legal entities and currencies, ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent financial information.
Manage and mentor accounting professionals across general accounting, reconciliations, and other core finance functions.
Oversee monthly and year-end financial close processes, financial reporting, and multi-entity consolidation.
Review financial Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), validate financial information, and provide analysis to support business decisions.
Develop financial models and revenue or costing scenarios as required to support strategic planning.
Oversee Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and bank and merchant reconciliations across multiple entities.
Maintain consistent accounting policies, procedures, and chart of accounts across the organization.
Partner with the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) on cash flow management, treasury reporting, and banking relationships.
Design, document, and maintain effective internal controls appropriate for a multi-entity organization operating across jurisdictions.
Serve as the primary finance contact for external auditors and coordinate annual audit and review engagements.
Support financial, regulatory, and compliance reporting requirements across the organization's operating jurisdictions.
Lead the optimization of accounting systems, integrations, automation, and financial processes.
Establish scalable month-end close and reporting processes to support continued organizational growth.
Partner with internal technology and development teams on finance-related systems, reporting tools, and process improvements.
Act as a trusted financial advisor to senior leadership and department leaders, providing analysis and insight to support operational and strategic decision-making.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline is required.
Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation in good standing is required.

Qualifications:

Strong knowledge of Canadian accounting standards, including Accounting Standards for Private Enterprises (ASPE) and/or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working hands-on with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) or accounting systems.
Strong understanding of full-cycle accounting and financial reporting.
Experience working within a multi-entity environment with multiple currencies is highly preferred.
Cross-border accounting experience involving Canada and the United States (US) is considered a strong asset.

Experience:

Minimum 7 years of progressive accounting experience with increasing responsibility.
Minimum 3 years of experience in a Controller, Assistant Controller, Vice President, Finance Director, or senior accounting leadership role.
Experience leading accounting teams while remaining comfortable maintaining a hands-on approach to financial operations.
Experience within financial services, payments, fintech, or another regulated industry is considered a strong asset.
Experience supporting United States (US) accounting, reporting, or federal and state filing requirements is preferred.
Experience implementing or improving accounting systems, automation, reporting processes, or financial controls is highly desirable.

Skills:

Leadership: Confident financial leader who can provide direction to accounting teams while remaining hands-on when required.
Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to interpret complex financial information, identify trends, and develop practical recommendations.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly present financial information to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
Organization: Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple entities, priorities, reporting cycles, and deadlines simultaneously.
Problem-Solving: Resourceful and solutions-oriented, with the ability to navigate evolving priorities and complex financial matters.
Business Acumen: Ability to connect financial performance with broader operational and strategic objectives.
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a growing environment where processes and priorities continue to evolve.
Relationship Building: Collaborative approach with the ability to establish credibility and strong working relationships across the organization.

Base Salary:
$180,000- 210,000+ per year
Salary is based on experience and qualifications.
Comprehensive compensation and benefits package.
Opportunity to play a key leadership role in a growing organization with a broad, multi-entity financial mandate.

Work Hours:

Full-time, permanent position.
Monday – Friday.
Fully in-office position in Calgary, Alberta.

Additional Notes:

This opportunity does not include relocation. It will be the responsibility of the candidate should relocation be required.
All applicants must be authorized to work in Canada to be considered for employment.

Come light up the world as a Sales Director, Platform Sales!

As a member of our sales team, the Sales Director generates multiple revenue streams by identifying customer needs and offering solutions from Broadsign’s diverse line of products. 5+ years of experience selling enterprise B2B software, with full quota ownership and a demonstrated history of exceeding targets
Proven success in new logo acquisition, including outbound prospecting, pipeline generation, and building targeted account plans
Experience developing and managing a robust pipeline while establishing trusted, strategic relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders
Strong collaborator and team player, able to work cross-functionally with Broadsign’s internal stakeholders to deliver customer-centric solutions
Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to think creatively, adapt to unexpected situations, and operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy
Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Strong leadership presence with a clear understanding of the value of teamwork and shared accountability
Fluency in French and English
Solid understanding and practical application of the Challenger Sales methodology
Experience with platform-led selling in adtech; familiarity with the Out-of-Home (OOH) advertising industry is preferred

jobs.description:
Job Description

Some of what you will do:

The Director, Digital Growth & Media Marketing is responsible for leading Staples Canada's digital growth strategy, media investment, customer lifecycle marketing, and social media ecosystem across B2C and B2B. This role is accountable for driving customer acquisition, engagement, retention, traffic, and revenue through a portfolio of paid, owned, and earned channels.

The Director will lead teams responsible for performance media, SEM, CRM and email marketing, paid and organic social media, marketing technology, and digital marketing effectiveness. This leader will partner closely with Integrated Marketing, Creative & Production, Analytics, eCommerce, Digital Experience, and Business (i.e. B2B, Merchandising, Digital, Services) teams to ensure digital investments drive measurable business outcomes and support enterprise growth objectives.

As a member of the Marketing Leadership Team, this role will champion innovation, customer-centric marketing, personalization, and data-driven decision making while advancing Staples Canada's digital marketing capabilities.

Specifically, You Will

Digital Growth Strategy & Marketing Transformation

Lead the digital growth strategy across B2C and B2B, ensuring paid, owned, and earned channels are aligned to enterprise revenue, traffic, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention goals.
Advance Staples Canada’s shift toward a more digital-first, customer-centric marketing organization through clear roadmaps, capability building, test-and-learn practices, and cross-functional adoption.

Performance Media, SEM & Full-Funnel Investment

Oversee performance media strategy across search, shopping, display, programmatic, paid social, affiliate, retail media, and other growth channels.
Set investment strategy and budget allocation by business objective, audience, funnel stage, and expected return, balancing customer acquisition, demand generation, profitability, and brand-building outcomes.
Lead agency, platform, and partner relationships to ensure media plans are strategically sound, commercially efficient, and aligned to business priorities.

CRM, Email & Customer Lifecycle Marketing

Lead CRM, email, SMS, and lifecycle marketing strategies that deepen customer engagement, increase retention, and drive profitable sales across key customer segments.
Accelerate personalization, automation, segmentation, and triggered communications using customer data, behavioural insights, and marketing technology capabilities.
Develop differentiated lifecycle strategies for B2C and B2B audiences, including business customers (e.g. Preferred Customers, Small Medium Businesses, Enterprise Businesses) and other high-value segments.

Paid & Organic Social Media Ecosystem

Own the strategic direction for paid and organic social media, ensuring Staples Canada builds an integrated, brand-right, performance-oriented social ecosystem.
Partner closely with Integrated Marketing, Creative & Production, PR/Communications, and agency partners to align social content, community engagement, campaign amplification, and performance optimization.

Marketing Technology, Personalization & Digital Effectiveness

Lead the identification, evaluation, business case development, and optimization of marketing technology capabilities that enable personalization, automation, audience activation, measurement, and channel efficiency.
Partner with eCommerce, Digital Experience, Analytics, IT, and external vendors to improve digital marketing effectiveness across the customer journey.

Cross-Functional Planning, B2B/B2C Growth & Business Partnership

Act as a strategic partner to business, marketing, merchandising, eCommerce, digital experience, and services stakeholders to ensure digital investments support enterprise priorities.
Develop scalable approaches that support both B2C and B2B growth, with sufficient focus on business customer acquisition, nurture, retention, and account-based or segment-led marketing opportunities.

Some Of What You Need

University degree in business, marketing, commerce, digital marketing, analytics, or a related discipline.
MBA or advanced education in marketing, business, digital transformation, analytics, or related field considered an asset.
Deep knowledge of digital growth marketing across paid, owned, and earned channels, including performance media, SEM, CRM/email, paid and organic social, and lifecycle marketing.
Strong understanding of B2C and B2B customer acquisition, engagement, retention, demand generation, and full-funnel marketing strategies.
Demonstrated expertise in media investment strategy, budget allocation, channel optimization, agency management, and marketing performance measurement.
Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret marketing, customer, digital, and financial metrics and translate insights into clear business recommendations.
Knowledge of marketing technology, personalization, segmentation, automation, first-party data activation, and customer journey orchestration.
Familiarity with key digital and marketing platforms such as Google Ads, Google Analytics, paid social platforms, CRM/email platforms, marketing automation tools, and reporting dashboards.
Minimum 10+ years of progressive digital marketing, media, CRM, lifecycle marketing, eCommerce, or growth marketing experience, preferably in retail, omni-channel, B2B/B2C, or customer-led environments.
5+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers and/or multi-disciplinary teams.
Experience owning significant media, digital marketing, or MarTech budgets with accountability for performance, optimization, and return on investment.
Experience leading agency, platform, vendor, and technology partner relationships.
Experience building or scaling digital marketing capabilities, personalization programs, lifecycle marketing strategies, or test-and-learn operating models.
Experience partnering cross-functionally with eCommerce, analytics, merchandising, creative, integrated marketing, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Physical Demands/working Conditions

Office environment – Hybrid, with 4 days onsite in Richmond Hill, subject to the hybrid policy.

Some Of What You Will Get

Associate discount
Health and Dental benefits
RRSP/DPSP
Performance bonuses
Learning & Development programs
And more...

new_jobs.description:
About Staffing®
is an Alberta-based recruitment company that connects jobseekers to employers across Canada. Established in 1996, About Staffing is a proud BBB Accredited business.

We have partnered with a growing financial services organization to support them in hiring for their next Vice President, Finance
.

Job ID: 43264
Job Type: Direct Hire
Category: Accounting & Finance
Location: Calgary, Alberta
Work Model: In-Office

Our SE Calgary client is a growing financial services organization with operations across Canada and the United States. With multiple business entities and a fast-moving environment, the organization is continuing to build scalable financial processes, strengthen reporting capabilities, and support its next stage of growth.

The culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and solutions-focused. This is an environment where priorities can evolve quickly, and leaders are expected to be hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable working across departments. Strong communication and the ability to build effective relationships with senior leadership and cross-functional teams are highly valued.

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), the Vice President, Finance will lead the accounting function across multiple Canadian and United States (US) entities. This is a hands-on leadership position responsible for financial reporting, consolidation, accounting operations, internal controls, compliance, and process improvement. The successful candidate will bring both technical accounting expertise and strong business acumen, with the ability to translate financial information into meaningful insights for senior leadership.

Duties and Responsibilities:

The key job functions are:
Lead the accounting function across multiple legal entities and currencies, ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent financial information.
Manage and mentor accounting professionals across general accounting, reconciliations, and other core finance functions.
Oversee monthly and year-end financial close processes, financial reporting, and multi-entity consolidation.
Review financial Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), validate financial information, and provide analysis to support business decisions.
Develop financial models and revenue or costing scenarios as required to support strategic planning.
Oversee Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and bank and merchant reconciliations across multiple entities.
Maintain consistent accounting policies, procedures, and chart of accounts across the organization.
Partner with the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) on cash flow management, treasury reporting, and banking relationships.
Design, document, and maintain effective internal controls appropriate for a multi-entity organization operating across jurisdictions.
Serve as the primary finance contact for external auditors and coordinate annual audit and review engagements.
Support financial, regulatory, and compliance reporting requirements across the organization's operating jurisdictions.
Lead the optimization of accounting systems, integrations, automation, and financial processes.
Establish scalable month-end close and reporting processes to support continued organizational growth.
Partner with internal technology and development teams on finance-related systems, reporting tools, and process improvements.
Act as a trusted financial advisor to senior leadership and department leaders, providing analysis and insight to support operational and strategic decision-making.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline is required.
Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation in good standing is required.

Qualifications:

Strong knowledge of Canadian accounting standards, including Accounting Standards for Private Enterprises (ASPE) and/or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working hands-on with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) or accounting systems.
Strong understanding of full-cycle accounting and financial reporting.
Experience working within a multi-entity environment with multiple currencies is highly preferred.
Cross-border accounting experience involving Canada and the United States (US) is considered a strong asset.

Experience:

Minimum 7 years of progressive accounting experience with increasing responsibility.
Minimum 3 years of experience in a Controller, Assistant Controller, Vice President, Finance Director, or senior accounting leadership role.
Experience leading accounting teams while remaining comfortable maintaining a hands-on approach to financial operations.
Experience within financial services, payments, fintech, or another regulated industry is considered a strong asset.
Experience supporting United States (US) accounting, reporting, or federal and state filing requirements is preferred.
Experience implementing or improving accounting systems, automation, reporting processes, or financial controls is highly desirable.

Skills:

Leadership: Confident financial leader who can provide direction to accounting teams while remaining hands-on when required.
Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to interpret complex financial information, identify trends, and develop practical recommendations.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly present financial information to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
Organization: Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple entities, priorities, reporting cycles, and deadlines simultaneously.
Problem-Solving: Resourceful and solutions-oriented, with the ability to navigate evolving priorities and complex financial matters.
Business Acumen: Ability to connect financial performance with broader operational and strategic objectives.
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a growing environment where processes and priorities continue to evolve.
Relationship Building: Collaborative approach with the ability to establish credibility and strong working relationships across the organization.

Base Salary:
$180,000- 210,000+ per year
Salary is based on experience and qualifications.
Comprehensive compensation and benefits package.
Opportunity to play a key leadership role in a growing organization with a broad, multi-entity financial mandate.

Work Hours:

Full-time, permanent position.
Monday – Friday.
Fully in-office position in Calgary, Alberta.

Additional Notes:

This opportunity does not include relocation. It will be the responsibility of the candidate should relocation be required.
All applicants must be authorized to work in Canada to be considered for employment.

About Staffing®
recruiters are Alberta’s experts in connecting candidates with accounting jobs. We focus on temporary, direct hire (permanent) and temporary-to-direct hire placements in the corporate and industrial fields.

The About Staffing team would like to thank everyone who applies. Please note we are only contacting applicants who meet the employer’s needs of the positions we are actively working on.
